name: Sref_Cref_Benchmark_800_FreeStyle
description: A benchmark for evaluating models' ability to detect and resolve references and coreferent mentions in free-form text. The dataset contains 800 examples aimed at testing citation/reference linking and coreference resolution in varied writing styles. It is intended for information-extraction and reference-understanding evaluation in NLP systems.
reputation: Small, recently published Hugging Face dataset with limited community uptake so far.
